title: 第316章 师兄哪吒12姐姐真不乖第315章 师兄哪吒这个姐姐真不听话得好好教才行
slug: 西游恶人攻略录哪吒总骗我亲他
lines: 翌日，天色尚未彻底放亮。
这一回，江盼竟比身侧的灵珠子先醒了过来。
怀里的小家伙睡得安稳，小身子蜷缩着，呼吸匀净绵长。
她凝神打量片刻，确定那双眸子不会骤然睁开，才放轻动作，小心翼翼地将胳膊从他怀中抽离。
灵珠子含糊地咕哝了几句梦话，顺势翻了个身，伸手搂住枕边的软枕，依旧沉睡着。
江盼蹑手蹑脚下床，拢上外衫，悄无声息地推门走了出去。
李长寿的居所相隔不远，穿过两道曲折回廊便到了。
她抬手叩了叩房门，屋内毫无动静。
接连又敲了三下，木门“吱呀”
一声缓缓敞开。
李长寿衣衫松散，长发随意披散，倚在门框上，睡眼惺忪地打了个长长的哈欠。
“……我说老乡，你可知现在是什么时辰？”
“我有要事问你。”
见她神色郑重，李长寿无奈一叹，侧身让出位置。
“进来再说吧。”
屋内燃着一盏孤灯，暖黄的光晕将周遭衬得朦胧昏沉。
李长寿斟了一杯热茶递过来，随即在对面落座，抬手揉了揉发胀的眉心。
“什么事急成这样？灵珠子呢？”
“还在睡。”
江盼接过茶杯，指尖扣着杯壁并未饮用，开门见山，“我来向你打听一个人。”
李长寿眉梢微挑：“哦？何人？”
江盼唇瓣动了动，仔细斟酌着措辞。
“灵珠子……他体内，会不会存在两个意识？”
话音落下，李长寿端着茶杯的手猛地一顿。
他没有立刻作答，慢悠悠饮了一口茶水，抬眸看向她。
“你为何会生出这种想法？”
江盼咬了咬下唇：“你早前便提醒过我，说他绝非表面看上去那般简单。
你是不是早就察觉到了什么？”
李长寿放下茶盏，向后靠在椅背上，指尖轻叩桌面，似在权衡该透露几分。
“谈不上知晓，”
他缓缓开口，“我只是一直心存疑虑。”
“疑虑什么？”
“你难道没发觉，如今的灵珠子，很多时候都不像原本的他？”
江盼心头骤然一紧：“譬如？”
“就拿看我的眼神来说。”
李长寿指了指自己的双眼，“从前是天真乖巧，一口一个师叔亲近有加；如今再对上，那目光倒像是在问——师叔为什么还活着。”
江盼一时语塞。
“不止这些。”
content_en:
The next day, the sky was not completely bright yet.
This time, Jiang Pan actually woke up before Lingzhu beside him.
The little guy in his arms slept peacefully, with his little body curled up and his breathing even and long.
She looked at him intently for a moment, making sure that those eyes would not open suddenly, then she moved gently and carefully pulled her arms away from his arms.
Lingzhuzi mumbled a few words in his sleep, turned over, put his arms around the soft pillow, and still fell asleep.
Jiang Pan tiptoed out of bed, put on his coat, quietly opened the door and walked out.
Li Changshou's residence is not far from each other and can be reached through two winding corridors.
She raised her hand and knocked on the door, but there was no movement in the room.
After knocking three times in succession, the wooden door creaked.
A sound slowly opened.
Li Changshou was wearing loose clothes and his long hair was casually disheveled. He leaned against the door frame and let out a long yawn sleepily.
"...fellow fellow, do you know what time it is now?"
"I have something important to ask you."
Seeing her solemn expression, Li Changshou sighed helplessly and stepped aside to give up his position.
"Let's talk after we come in."
There was a solitary lamp burning in the room, and its warm yellow halo made the surroundings hazy.
Li Changshou poured a cup of hot tea and handed it over, then sat down opposite him and raised his hand to rub his swollen eyebrows.
"What's so urgent? Where is the spirit bead?"
"Still sleeping."
Jiang Pan took the tea cup and pressed his fingertips against the side of the cup without drinking. He went straight to the point, "I'm here to ask you about someone."
Li Changshou raised his eyebrows slightly: "Oh? Who is it?"
Jiang Pan's lips moved and he carefully considered his words.
"Lingzhu...will there be two consciousnesses in his body?"
After the words fell, Li Changshou's hand holding the tea cup suddenly stopped.
He didn't answer immediately. He took a slow sip of tea and raised his eyes to look at her.
"Why did you come up with this idea?"
Jiang Pan bit his lower lip: "You reminded me earlier that he is not as simple as he seems on the surface.
Have you noticed something already? "
Li Changshou put down the tea cup, leaned back in his chair, and tapped his fingertips on the table, as if weighing how much to reveal.
"It's not like knowing."
He spoke slowly, "I just always had doubts."
"What are your concerns?"
"Don't you realize that Ling Zhuzi today is often not like his original self?"
Jiang Pan's heart suddenly tightened: "For example?"
"Just take the look in my eyes."
Li Changshou pointed to his own eyes, "In the past, he was innocent and well-behaved, and he always got close to each other. But now when we meet him again, his eyes seem to be asking why the uncle is still alive."
Jiang Pan was speechless for a moment.
"It's more than that."
